answer: Wine that never sours betrays the cellar. A ring of forty forged accounts can be minted in one night, but none of them can age forty epochs in unison. So weigh every vote by its vintage: the ledger notes when an account first drew a witness, and influence ripens only with witnessed activity. A ripple of old-weight diffuses slowly across the atlas of seats; pigment rubbed onto a fresh cask will not color yesterday. Sybils must spend real time, not just tokens.
